effect_description_eng:
This card is also treated as [Shoutmon] for a DigiXros.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less.
[On Deletion] Place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait from your hand or trash under your Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon with the [Xros Heart] trait gains ＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.).
